# Levo

> Levo is a Mac menubar app that watches disk, memory, CPU and GPU. Your own agent CLI works out what is safe to clean or quit, read-only and in a sandbox, and Levo cleans only what you tick. Made by Cntxt Labs.

- Needs macOS 26 or later. No Levo account and no Levo server.
- Works with the agent CLI you already use: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot, opencode, Qwen Code, Kimi CLI, Grok CLI, or a custom command.
- The agent can only read. Nothing it says can delete a file, quit an app or change a setting.
- Free to watch and suggest. A lifetime licence, currently US$5, unlocks cleaning.
- Signed and notarised by Cntxt Labs (team ID 5X94H5ZCD4).
